users.title: Users
users.name: Name
users.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently deletes the account, packages, and all related data. This action cannot be undone.
users.aiAdjustCreditsHint: A positive value grants credits, a negative one revokes them. A grant settles outstanding debt first, and a revoke cannot exceed the current balance.
users.aiAdjustCreditsConfirmDescription: This changes the user's additional credits by {{amount}} units. The action is recorded in the audit log.
users.aiAdjustMonthlyUsageHint: Set the consumed amount directly, between 0 and {{limit}} units.
users.aiAdjustMonthlyUsageDisabled: The monthly allowance belongs to a Pro billing period, so it can only be changed for users with an active plan.
users.aiAdjustMonthlyUsageConfirmDescription: This sets the consumed amount to {{value}} units. The action is recorded in the audit log.
users.aiResetMonthlyUsageConfirmDescription: This returns the consumed amount to 0, making the full monthly allowance available again. The action is recorded in the audit log.
users.aiAdjustFailed: Failed to update the AI plan

ai.title: AI settings
ai.description: Change the model each AI operation uses and how many usage units it costs. Changes apply to operations started afterwards; jobs already running keep the price reserved when they started.

models.title: Models on offer
models.description: Users pick one of these per request and are charged that model's price. A request that names none runs on the default. Changes here are saved with the rest of the page.
models.emptyDescription: None registered, so this operation runs on the built-in model below. Registering one replaces it.
models.unsupportedByProvider: This model accepts none of the resolutions, lengths or aspect ratios this feature sends. Every request that picks it will fail; replace it with another model.
models.economicsPending: Enter a model ID to see what it costs to run.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: Usage units granted to each Pro subscription every billing period. A change applies to operations started afterwards and to the remaining balance shown to users; already consumed usage is left as it is.
plan.digest: In practice: median {{median}} units, 90th percentile {{p90}} units, {{exhausted}}% exhausted the allowance (across {{accounts}} accounts).
plan.digestEmpty: There is not enough usage yet to judge whether the allowance fits.
plan.unaffordableTitle: Some operations cost more than the allowance
plan.unaffordableDescription: These operations are priced above the {{limit}}-unit monthly allowance: {{operations}}. They cannot be started without purchased credits.

source.mismatch: The Stripe price differs from the recorded offer. Purchases still settle against the recorded terms.

error.notConfigured: No Stripe price ID is configured, so it cannot be looked up.
error.unavailable: Could not be read from Stripe.

economics.costNote: Costs are estimated from OpenRouter's published rates. What was actually billed is not recorded, so real spend will differ.

assumption.imageInputNotPriced: the endpoint prices no separate reference-image charge, so the edit's input image is not counted
assumption.transcriptionMinute: exactly one minute of audio (billing rounds up, so real cost is at most this)

economics.costRatioForeignCurrency: The cost ratio needs revenue and provider cost in the same currency. Store prices are in {{currency}} and provider costs are quoted in USD, and no exchange rate is configured here.

usage.title: AI usage
usage.description: AI jobs and usage units aggregated over the selected window. Per-user balances are adjusted from each user's detail page.
usage.consumedUnitsHint: Net of refunds returned by failed jobs
usage.jobCountHint: AI jobs started within the window
usage.activeSubscriptionsHint: Each plan is granted {{limit}} units per period
usage.purchasedCreditsHint: Credits bought within the window, net of refunds and disputes
usage.balanceDescription: What every account holds right now, independent of the selected window.
usage.adjustmentDescription: Manual corrections made from the admin console within the window. The audit log records who made each one.

distribution.title: How much of the allowance is used
distribution.description: Consumption per account within the current billing period. It reflects the present state regardless of the window selected above. The allowance is currently {{limit}} units.
distribution.projected: Extrapolated to the end of the period: median {{p50}} units, 90th percentile {{p90}} units (from {{sampleSize}} accounts).
distribution.scope: {{measured}} of {{accounts}} accounts. Excluded: {{stale}} whose billing period has already ended, and {{withoutPeriod}} that never held the plan.
distribution.noData: No account can be summarized yet ({{stale}} excluded because their billing period has ended, {{withoutPeriod}} because they never held the plan).
distribution.censoredNote: Consumption stops once the allowance runs out, so the upper percentiles understate real demand. Read them together with the exhaustion rate.
distribution.midPeriodNote: An account partway through its period always reads low. The extrapolated figures scale by elapsed time and leave out accounts less than 10% into their period.
distribution.purchasedNote: {{holders}} accounts hold purchased credits, which indicates demand beyond the allowance.
distribution.truncatedNote: More accounts exist than the {{limit}} scanned, so these figures cover only the first {{limit}}.

common.forbidden: This account does not have administrator access.
